note: v473: Fixes business statement months that stopped balancing. When you have two banks linked, the app quietly reconciles the other one in the background — and if one of your business expenses happened to match a personal bank line by amount and date, it got claimed by that account and withheld from the business statement, leaving the real business bank line with nothing to match. Those background guesses are no longer treated as final: a record still matches on the account whose statement actually shows it. Nothing to re-enter — reopen your months and they should balance again.
